hypotheses.subject: api.io-pay.example
hypotheses.summary: io-shop's payment provider dependency (api.io-pay.example) began returning HTTP 503 for card lookups starting at 16:06:00Z, causing account-page requests that touch payment info to fail; error rate rose from baseline ~1% to 100% and latency spiked (p50 44ms -> 2045ms) in lockstep with the PaymentProviderFailed errors. No deploys or config changes were recorded in the preceding weeks, ruling out a code or config change on io-shop's side.

hypotheses.summary: If the 503s from api.io-pay.example are themselves a symptom rather than root cause (e.g. that service's own upstream or infra failed), the true origin lies further upstream than what io-shop's evidence can show; no cause internal to io-shop (no deploy, no config change, no resource exhaustion) is visible.
